text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Damn, just how many did you catch!?
choice_data_list:
I'll give you all of it. For your little 
brother and for you.

I'll give you all of it. For your little 
brother and for you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no way, I don't need it! You won 
it, so it's yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she wants to give it to him. She 
might not be honest about it, but she 
tried over and over to win that plushie 
for her little brother.
choice_data_list:
I wanted to give a present to someone as 
devoted to their family as you.

I wanted to give a present to someone as 
devoted to their family as you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Wh-Who are you calling that, huh?! I 
just did this on a whim, I tell ya!
choice_data_list: Still, I really want you to take it.
Still, I'd really like you to have it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! Well, if you insist that much... I 
guess I could take it off your hands.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to tell my little bro. 
...That you're the one who won this for 
him."
